# Accent selection, inheritance and explicit Overunderset policy

The two generators use the unmodified D2 v0.8.1 MathJax 3.2.2 assets, verified by SHA-256. Each case/mode starts a fresh VM. The registered-MathML generator runs the primary inherited-attribute and TeX-class passes and records full trees, resolved/explicit/inherited attributes, prime state, `mo.isAccent`, and complete SVG hashes. The public generator records the actual TeX AST and full SVG without overlays.

This is one atomic D051/D055 fix: the primary accent getter distinguishes the internal positioning marker from accent context; the Accent constructor and inherited pass provide that context; Overunderset explicitly disables its script accents. Correcting only the getter/constructor/inheritance makes an authored explicit-true Overunderset example differently wrong, while changing Overunderset alone leaves its old wrong output. The combination matches the primary AST and complete SVG. Movable-limit normalization and Overset/Underset dispatch are separate work.

- All 36 public complete SVGs and 18 display measurements are strict primary references. Thirty-two projected ASTs are exact; four untouched over/under-arrow controls retain only their preexisting explicit parent `accent:true`/`accentunder:true` where the primary leaves the attribute implicit. Every other tree field is compared.
- All 52 registered primary getter and inheritance observations are strict, including explicit true, false, null and absence, display/prime re-inheritance and grouped cores. Forty-six complete SVGs match the raw primary hash.
- Four ordinary internal `mathaccent:false/null` modes retain the immutable complete accepted-baseline hashes in `internal/svg/testdata/accent_policy_unchanged_internal.json`. This property is not accepted by public `mmlToken`; these are an internal renderer boundary, not claimed primary rendering parity or a confirmed Studio issue. No false-marker positioning/stretch changes are included.
- Only the two named `both-mixed` modes permit a single literal transform spelling: `translate(313.8,31) translate(-250 0)` to `translate(63.8,31)` on one exact `mo` tag. The entire remaining SVG must hash to the primary. Duplicate, offset, path and root mutations reject. Independent evidence confirms exact-decimal composed path positions, styles and root attributes; no tolerance, fitted offset or general normalization is used.

The accepted 96 Physics vector complete-SVG assertions remain unchanged. Twenty-two now-obsolete AST qualifications for explicit mover accent were removed because the candidate produces the primary implicit state. The unrelated two `clap` attribute defaults remain qualified. The existing eight selected stretch/alias assertions now run in a real inherited accent context rather than using a marker alone as a synthetic accent.
